purpose: Read-only source-derived geometry reference validation, not an approved Golden or production C++ sampling result.
source: original MATLAB geometry source faces and A/B/C/D midpoint recursion, all source files remain unchanged

independent_wolfram.method: Per-row per-coordinate subtraction, original 20-face icosahedron F order, 30-digit golden ratio, double comparison. The session used ImportString with the same source JSON rows because the GitHub file is not mounted inside Wolfram tool.

footnotes: The first attempt accidentally omitted face {11,3,7} in the temporary evaluator code and caused an icosa shape mismatch. It was corrected against the original F table, and the committed replay script explicitly guards face count 20.
This is actual Mathematica-vs-JavaScript candidate rowwise comparison for all stored 714 rows, not just a row-weighted checksum; it is not independent C++ sampling execution.
Tolerance 1e-12 is a comparison diagnostic for this independent check, not approved DEC-005 final scientific acceptance.
No MATLAB/Octave runtime used; no original source files or original archived MAT datasets modified.
Hashes are SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 file contents retrieved at fixed GitHub blobs and calculated using Wolfram ByteArray; not Git blob SHA values.
